title: Video Consultations for Non-emergency Acute Conditions at All Polyclinics
what_it_is: Video Consultations for Non-emergency Acute Conditions at All Polyclinics

sections.label: Polyclinic video consultations availability
sections.summary: Not all polyclinics offer video consultations for non-emergency acute conditions; SingHealth Polyclinics runs a pilot with no immediate broad expansion plans.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Hoe
sentences.text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (a) whether all polyclinics currently offer video consultations for non-emergency acute conditions in a primary care setting; (b) if not, whether there are plans for polyclinics not offering such telemedicine services to introduce them; and (c) if so, what are the expected timelines for implementation in these polyclinics.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This ensures adequate clinical evaluation of medical conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: At the point of teleconsultation, if new or worsening conditions are identified, the video consultation will not proceed and the patient will be advised to seek an in-person consultation instead.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Teleconsultations for common acute symptoms like cough and cold with accompanying medical certificate issuance are not typically offered because these are already well-provided for by private sector players.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: And while SingHealth Polyclinics currently offers this service under a cluster-run pilot, there are no immediate plans for a broad-based expansion across all polyclinics.

sections.label: All clusters offer follow-up video
sections.summary: All three polyclinic clusters currently offer video consultation for follow-up of acute conditions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: On his first question regarding services provided at three polyclinics, let me just clarify with him that actually all three polyclinic clusters currently do offer video consultation for follow-up of acute conditions.

sections.label: Risk stratification in video care
sections.summary: Video consultations risk stratify patients so care is not compromised; SingHealth's first-attendance acute video service remains a pilot with no expansion plans.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, it is really to just risk stratify and make sure that even while we offer convenience for the patients, their care is not compromised.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And SingHealth Polyclinics, while they also offer acute video consultation for the first attendance, as I said earlier, this is still under a pilot and there are currently no plans to expand this.

sections.label: MOH monitoring SingHealth pilot
sections.summary: MOH monitors the SingHealth Polyclinics pilot to learn lessons and assess wider implementation; the pilot has a cut-off age of 18 years old.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: MOH is monitoring the progress of the pilot by SingHealth Polyclinics and we will take lessons from that and see whether there is a scope for us to implement it more widely, and also to learn from it and see how it reflects or complements what the private sector is already currently providing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: His third clarification on the age criteria, SingHealth Polyclinics in the pilot project has a cut-off age of 18 years old, but this is based on the polyclinic's definition of what is deemed as a child and what is deemed as an adult.
